question.html:
A vertical tube of length mm that is open at both ends is partially immersed in water. A sound source placed above the tube emits sound towards the tube. The diagram shows the position of the tube when % of the tube is immersed in water.

At this position the intensity of the sound detected is a maximum, because a standing sound wave forms in the tube.

a. Outline how a standing wave is formed in the tube.

   [2]

The tube is moved vertically downwards. A maximum sound intensity is detected three more times before the tube is fully immersed in water. The last position where a maximum sound intensity is detected as the tube is immersed is when mm of the tube is above the water surface.

b. Sketch the standing wave in the tube at this position.

   [1]

The speed of sound at the position of the tube is m s. 

c. Find the frequency of the standing wave that is formed in the tube when a maximum sound intensity is detected for the second time after the tube begins to move downwards.
